boundedRepairPlan: Expose bounded source-condition rejection details (cause and retained control references) through the SDK evidence contract, without changing equivalence decisions.

When historical equivalence is explicitly required, defer only a source proven unassessable by the SDK. Retain it as unresolved and inspect other sources/items. Do not equate absent optional legacy API fields with proven impossibility.

Keep current-material unknown waiting bound to the exact source and actual material facts; changes must invalidate this waiting state. A/B different branches remain eligible for recovery, and requireSourceEquivalent=false still permits new review material.
Use a review-source-specific failure reason for zero-action source-proof refusal; preserve strict checkpoint verification and global unknown-execution blocking.

Use a small offline regression covering incomplete source/other item advancement, hidden nonlocal mode change, different A/B recovery eligibility, and unknown execution across restart. Keep unchanged-material work bounded. Run a real browser window only after that checkpoint passes.
